description: The best cuts in one gemstone for what matters to the buyer: overall light performance, brilliance, fire, scintillation (sparkle), spread (looks bigger for its weight), tilt (stays bright when tilted) or leakage (least light lost). Filter by family or outline. Returns a ranked short list with each cut's page and checkout links.

priority.description: What to rank by; leakage ranks the least light lost first. overall if left out.
